summary: check:utilities had three blind spots, all surfaced by Input being the first component to use border-* colours (Button draws its resting edge with a ring). It had no border- namespace at all, so every border colour in the library went unchecked; it skipped only bracket arbitrary values, making every parens custom-property utility a false positive; and its variant list omitted placeholder/enabled/checked/has-/not-/group-/peer-, so those utilities were silently skipped. Coverage went from 67 to 80 checked utilities on the same source. All three paths probed failing-first.

migration.manual: None — the gate now checks more, and passes.
